title: Concept: JWT 'none' algorithm (python) — review required
description: In python, algorithms=["none"] names unsecured JWTs. The 'none' algorithm exists for special cases, but verifiers that accept it let attackers forge any claim. The remedy is pinning HS256/RS256 pinning.
applicability: python JWT verification configuration; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Authentication bypass via self-minted tokens; HIGH severity.
